## Description {#details}

This header defines the <code>test&#95;reporter</code> class and associated types, which are responsible for formatting and outputting test results within the µTest++ framework.

The <code>test&#95;reporter</code> class provides a comprehensive set of output operators for various data types, containers, and comparator expressions, enabling detailed and informative reporting of test outcomes. It supports multiple verbosity levels and colour-coded output to distinguish between passed and failed tests.

The file also defines supporting types such as <code>colors</code> and <code>verbosity</code>, and includes methods for reporting the start and end of test cases and suites, as well as for handling pass and fail conditions.

All definitions reside within the <code><Link to="/docs/api/namespaces/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus">micro&#95;os&#95;plus::micro&#95;test&#95;plus</Link></code> namespace, ensuring clear separation from user code and minimising the risk of naming conflicts.

This file is intended to be included by users who wish to customise or extend test reporting within the µTest++ framework.
